pose_landmarks.description: Pose landmarks (x, y, z, visibility) from MediaPipe Holistic

pose_world_landmarks.description: Pose world landmarks (x, y, z, visibility)

left_hand_landmarks.description: Left hand landmarks (x, y, z). Zero if missing.

right_hand_landmarks.description: Right hand landmarks (x, y, z). Zero if missing.

frame_indices.description: Index of the frame in the original video

pose_mask.description: Boolean mask indicating if the pose landmark is valid (True) or missing/interpolated from too long gap (False)

left_hand_mask.description: Boolean mask for left hand landmarks

right_hand_mask.description: Boolean mask for right hand landmarks

kinematics.description: Kinematic features extracted from pose. Features: [L_shoulder_angle, R_shoulder_angle, L_elbow_angle, R_elbow_angle, trunk_inclination, L_shoulder_ang_vel, R_shoulder_ang_vel, L_elbow_ang_vel, R_elbow_ang_vel, trunk_inclination_ang_vel, L_wrist_vel, R_wrist_vel]. Angles in radians, velocities in units/s.
